title: Crab Salad Made with Imitation Crab

content.title: About
content.content: Crab salad made with imitation crab is prepared from crab sticks (surimi), mayonnaise, fresh vegetables and seasonings. Imitation crab is produced from fish paste, starch, egg white and flavorings, mimicking the taste and texture of real crab meat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Crab sticks were invented in Japan in the 1970s as a cheap alternative to real crab.
Imitation crab typically contains about 60 % fish, the rest being starch, egg white and flavor enhancers.
Crab salads are popular in Asia, Europe and North America as a quick picnic dish.
In Russia, crab salad is often served as a festive appetizer.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Imitation crab has less saturated fat than real seafood, making the salad lighter.

items.title: Source of protein
items.content: Crab sticks provide about 8 g of protein per 100 g, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The product contains vitamin B12 and B6, important for nervous system function and metabolism.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: It supplies iodine, zinc and selenium, which aid thyroid health and antioxidant defense.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: The soft texture of imitation crab is gentle on the stomach, suitable for people with sensitive digestion.

items.title: Fish allergy
items.content: Imitation crab contains fish, so it can trigger allergic reactions in fish‑allergic individuals.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Crab sticks are often salted; people monitoring sodium intake should watch portion size.

items.title: Additives and flavorings
items.content: The product may contain artificial flavorings and preservatives that some consumers prefer to avoid.

items.title: Calorie‑dense mayonnaise
items.content: Traditional recipes use mayonnaise, which adds significant calories and fat.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the salad chilled as an appetizer or light meal. It pairs well with bread, toast, rice crackers, or can be used as a filling for sushi rolls.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared salad in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2‑3 days. Do not leave imitation crab at room temperature for more than 4 hours.
